title_en: Last night I passed by your gate
en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Traditional-sounding song, origin unclear. Line 'Стани брате да би нестанало' is my reading: the sister urges the brother to get up, wishing the village gone; the speaker's meaning in the last stanza is a bit ambiguous.

lines.en: Last night I passed by your gate
In front of the gate a green meadow
in the meadow two white tents.

lines.cyr: Во шатори брат и сестра лежат
lines.lat: Vo šatori brat i sestra ležat
lines.en: In the tents a brother and sister lie

lines.cyr: братот спие, а сестрата го буди.
lines.lat: bratot spie, a sestrata go budi.
lines.en: the brother sleeps, and the sister wakes him.
Get up, brother, may it be gone
our village, fire has burned it.
If it burns, let it go up in flames
since I have no son of my own.
